title: Universal Capability Acquisition Register
purpose: Track discoverable open-source and source-available projects that may provide reusable capabilities. This register is a candidate backlog, not an integration approval, security clearance, licence opinion, or proof that any capability works in our environment.
governing_principles: PROOF BEFORE CLAIM. EVIDENCE BEFORE CONFIDENCE. VERIFICATION BEFORE COMPLETION.
Preserve distinct component identity, responsibility, licence obligations, and governance boundaries.
Prefer provider-neutral adapters and replaceable integrations over wholesale repository imports.
Discover capability gaps and methods, not repository-count targets.
No candidate is approved solely because it is popular, highly starred, or described as autonomous.
Human approval and external policy enforcement are required for high-impact actions.
Every accepted capability must have reproducible proof, rollback, provenance, and mirror parity.

scoring_model.rule: Do not collapse dimensions into a single average. A critical weakness in security, licence, maintenance, or resource fit blocks approval regardless of total score.

records.name: DeepAgents
records.intended_role: Higher-level agent harness candidate; evaluate above a lower-level orchestration runtime.
risks: Tool permissions and sandboxing must be enforced outside the model.
Validate current API maturity and dependency footprint.

records.name: LangGraph
records.intended_role: Candidate orchestration substrate for long-running, inspectable agent workflows.
risks: Avoid coupling domain logic directly to framework-specific state types.
Test persistence, recovery, and upgrade compatibility.

records.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
records.intended_role: Alternative orchestration candidate; compare against LangGraph before selecting a primary runtime.
risks: Potential overlap with LangGraph.
Confirm maturity, API stability, and cross-language operational costs.

records.name: OpenHands
records.intended_role: Candidate software-engineering agent platform; evaluate SDK and execution boundaries separately.

licence.reported: MIT for software-agent-sdk; verify each OpenHands repository/package independently

risks: Untrusted code execution requires strong isolation.
Do not infer one repository's licence applies to the whole OpenHands ecosystem.

records.name: Aider
records.intended_role: Candidate coding workflow/tool; compare for controlled patch generation and repository operations.
risks: Limit repository write scope and shell execution.
Test supported model providers and context limitations.

records.name: SWE-agent
records.intended_role: Research and benchmark candidate for issue-to-patch workflows.
risks: Verify current project status, licence, and reproducibility before further evaluation.

records.name: Browser Use
records.intended_role: Candidate high-level browser agent behind a restricted browser automation gateway.

licence.reported: MIT for open-source library; hosted services are separate

risks: Browser sessions may expose authenticated accounts and sensitive data.
Cloud browser, CAPTCHA, proxy, and hosted API features may be paid services.

records.name: Playwright MCP
records.intended_role: Candidate deterministic browser-control adapter and tool interface.
risks: MCP tool exposure must be allowlisted.
Separate browser profile, filesystem, downloads, and network permissions.

records.name: Stagehand
records.intended_role: Alternative browser SDK; benchmark against Browser Use and Playwright MCP.
risks: Potential overlap with other browser layers.
Review hosted Browserbase dependencies and service terms separately.

records.name: Skyvern
records.intended_role: Alternative candidate for visually variable enterprise portals.

licence.reported: AGPL-3.0 in research; verify exact current repository and component terms

risks: AGPL obligations may affect distribution and network deployment.
Review self-hosted versus hosted feature boundaries.

records.name: Kestra
records.intended_role: Candidate durable automation substrate; evaluate deployment and worker model.
risks: Determine which enterprise features require commercial terms.
Assess operational footprint and durable state requirements.

records.name: Activepieces
records.intended_role: Candidate connector ecosystem and user-facing workflow builder.

licence.reported: MIT Community Edition; enterprise/cloud features separately commercially licensed

risks: Commercially licensed enterprise paths exist in repository.
Audit each piece, credentials scope, and external service terms.

records.name: Temporal
records.intended_role: Alternative durable execution engine for critical long-running automation.
risks: May overlap with Kestra for orchestration; compare workflow semantics and operational burden.

records.name: Cognee
records.intended_role: Candidate memory and knowledge layer; keep storage provider replaceable.
risks: Benchmark extraction quality and retrieval grounding.
Review data retention, deletion, and embedding model requirements.

records.name: Mem0
records.intended_role: Alternative focused memory service/library.
risks: Verify repository versus hosted product boundaries and current licence.

records.name: Letta
records.intended_role: Alternative agent-memory architecture; compare with Cognee and Mem0.
risks: Potential overlap with agent harness and memory responsibilities.

records.name: Graphiti
records.intended_role: Candidate temporal graph component; compare as a Cognee complement or alternative.
risks: Confirm current ownership, maintenance, licence and database requirements.

records.name: Open Policy Agent
records.intended_role: External policy decision point for agent and tool actions.
risks: OPA decisions must be enforced by the actual execution gateway.
Define fail-closed behavior and policy test coverage.

records.name: OpenFGA
records.intended_role: Candidate identity and resource authorization layer.
risks: Avoid duplicating OPA policy responsibilities; define PDP/PIP boundaries.

records.name: gVisor
records.intended_role: Candidate isolation boundary for untrusted agent workloads.
risks: Requires compatible host infrastructure and operational expertise.
Not assumed suitable for direct Android deployment.

records.name: Wasmtime
records.intended_role: Candidate runtime for constrained, portable extensions and tools.

licence.reported: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception; verify current files

risks: WASM sandboxing is not a complete substitute for host isolation or network policy.

records.name: Promptfoo
records.intended_role: Adversarial and comparative test harness for agent/model behavior.
risks: Do not treat red-team coverage as proof of security.
Test tool-use and indirect prompt-injection scenarios.

records.name: DeepEval
records.intended_role: Quality metrics and repeatable evaluation suites.
risks: LLM-as-judge metrics require calibration and human-labelled validation.

records.name: Langfuse
records.intended_role: Candidate trace and observability platform.

licence.reported: MIT core; enterprise modules commercially licensed

risks: Enterprise modules have separate terms.
Tracing may capture sensitive prompts, tool inputs and outputs; apply redaction and retention policies.

records.name: Arize Phoenix
records.intended_role: Alternative observability platform; compare with Langfuse.

licence.reported: Elastic License 2.0 for Phoenix; verify each package separately

risks: ELv2 is not an OSI-approved open-source licence.
Different packages may have different licences.

records.name: llama.cpp
records.intended_role: Optional local inference provider; model weights and model licences remain separate.
risks: 4GB Android device is not assumed capable of useful workloads.
Model weights have independent licences and memory requirements.

records.name: LlamaIndex
records.intended_role: Candidate knowledge ingestion/retrieval framework; compare against Cognee's ingestion and graph features.
risks: Potential overlap with Cognee; define whether it is an ingestion adapter or a separate retrieval layer.

records.name: Qdrant
records.intended_role: Optional replaceable vector storage provider.
risks: Do not assume phone-resident deployment.
Review persistence, backup, access control and operational costs.

requirements: Confirm canonical upstream repository and owner.
Pin commit SHA or release tag.
Record retrieval date and source evidence.
Inspect root and nested licence files.
Inventory transitive dependencies, assets, models and datasets.
Record NOTICE and attribution obligations.
Separate self-hosted, hosted and enterprise features.
Inspect releases, commits, issue response and security advisories.
Check supported runtimes, API stability and upgrade path.
Identify overlapping candidates and alternatives.
Threat model tools and data access.
Test prompt injection and untrusted content handling.
Enforce least privilege outside the model.
Define sandbox, network, secrets and approval boundaries.
Benchmark CPU, RAM, storage, latency and network requirements.
Separate mobile client from remote execution infrastructure.
Record hosting costs and offline behavior.
Define measurable acceptance criteria.
Build an isolated proof of capability.
Run reproducible tests and negative tests.
Record failures and limitations.
Approve a narrow adapter contract.
Preserve provider identity and replaceability.
Review rollback and data migration.
Approval is not implementation.
Verify deployed version and configuration.
Run integration, security, reliability and performance tests.
Obtain independent review.
Update source and operational mirrors and detect drift.

next_actions: Confirm and pin upstream commit/release identities for P1 candidates.
Complete licence and dependency inventory before any code import or distribution.
Define provider-neutral contracts for agent runtime, tool gateway, memory, workflow execution, policy enforcement and evidence.
Create isolated proof-of-capability benchmarks for DeepAgents/LangGraph, OpenHands SDK, Browser Use/Playwright MCP, Kestra, Cognee and OPA/gVisor.
Do not integrate all candidates at once; select one vertical slice at a time.
Keep the existing six-source reconnaissance PR separate from this register unless a maintainer explicitly chooses to consolidate them.
non_claims: No candidate has been installed or integrated by this register.
No candidate has passed a security audit or operational benchmark.
Reported licences are research leads, not legal clearance; verify exact pinned revisions and all included components.
No upstream test suites were executed as part of this register creation.
Priority labels represent proposed evaluation order, not approval.
